description: Tobias Hofmeier and Martin Cichon publish Vir2Rail, a modular Unreal Engine environment for simulating LiDAR perception in railway settings. Users configure track geometry, catenary assets, sensor field of view, angular resolution, scan frequency and range. Point clouds can stream to external applications through UDP. The March 2026 archive includes source code and project assets, free under CC BY 4.0, and runs directly within the Unreal editor. Its configurable scenes have no fixed geographic coverage or observation period. Experimental material reflectivity and rain or snow attenuation models allow sensor-sensitivity studies and simulation-based railway-perception validation. Their physical accuracy was not independently tested, and Unreal version requirements remain unknown from the deposit. No related catalogue record is explicitly identified; the listed publication provides methodological context.
